verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost the same layout, and both have the same serious flaws. In both, the symptom list is re-wrapped so the six symptoms show as four lines ('Shortness of breath Dry cough', 'Sore throat Headache'), which breaks the '6 SYMPTOMS' count. The doctor illustration, which originally ran off the canvas edge, now ends in a hard cut inside the frame, and the yellow call-to-action is jammed against the bottom edge. A's 'SYMPTOMS' headline nearly touches the right edge and its margins are tighter. B has slightly more breathing room, but its list text is smaller, so B is better only by a small margin.
